scares.description: The security guard’s reflection stabs itself in the throat.
Ben looks at himself in a mirror when a bird suddenly flies away.
Ben looks up from the sink into the mirror and his reflected face is distorted.
Ben puts his hand against the mirror which then cracks.
Burning people appear in the mirror behind Ben.
A female voice begins screaming inside the building.
A hand pokes out of the room when Ben looks at it through the mirror.
The mother turns off the TV which cuts to Michael viewing a screaming woman in the mirror.
In the morgue, the reflection of Gary’s corpse abruptly turns sideways and speaks to Ben.
Ben looks into the car mirror and sees his sister sitting in the back seat.
Ben’s reflection pulls out a gun and shoots at Ben.
Amy bends down to look at Michael’s reflection in the water. She suddenly gets cut on the face by the reflection.
The female entity appears in the roofing above Ben.
The entity jumps down onto Ben.
Something breaks through the wall and jumps at Ben.
